ancient_context_cautions.second_temple: Second Temple materials may illuminate diaspora, holiness, temple/people, suffering, Noah, and apocalyptic discourse forms only; they cannot establish audience identity, fulfillment, canon, doctrine, or seams.
ancient_context_cautions.ancient_household: Greco-Roman and Jewish household conventions are context evidence only and cannot authorize slavery, gender, household, labor, or office policy.
ancient_context_cautions.ancient_imperial: Imperial and civic context may illuminate resident-alien and public-conduct language only; it cannot determine political policy, resistance/compliance rules, persecution history, date, or audience.
ancient_context_cautions.later_jewish_rabbinic: Later rabbinic reception remains later reception and cannot be projected backward as source identity or semantic authority.
ancient_context_cautions.patristic: Patristic reception may expose interpretive pressure but cannot select baptismal, descent, atonement, Christological, ecclesial, or supersessionist conclusions.

hardest_seams.why: vice-removal/growth can close 1:22-25 or open the living-stone/people movement; retain both routes
suffering/apology grounds flow into the exceptionally contested 3:18-22 movement; finer routes must not isolate proof texts
4:1 therefore links backward while 3:18-22 has its own comparison closure; preserve cross-chapter and local alternatives
end-frame gift register and doxology cohere, but doxology is not automatically independent
humility/anxiety, resistance, restoration and doxology may split finely, yet form one closing exhortation

premortem: Do not use chapter fallback, headings, paragraphs, citation labels, witness metadata, punctuation, or reception traditions as boundary authority.
Do not split every citation, imperative, participial clause, household item, suffering label, or doxology into separate units.
Do not detach an address from its example, command from grounds, citation from exposition, comparison from application, warning from consolation, or disputed clause from its larger argument.
Do not harmonize canonical echoes or use them to select fulfillment, supersession, witness, canon, doctrine, or theology.
Do not decide authorship, date, audience/identity/location, political/household/slavery/gender/office policy, baptism, afterlife, descent, atonement, Christology, persecution history, or chronology.
Keep exact alternatives and larger parents live; every decision remains LOW, deferred, candidate-only, non-authorizing, and without forced consensus.
